rawContent: I’ve not commented on #BlackLivesMatter yet but I’ll say this: I was a nurse. I cared for all sorts of people from all sorts of races & backgrounds. We all bleed, hurt, cry, love &rejoice the same. We are ALL equal & I’d stand should to shoulder with any black person to show that

I do know that I don’t want to see another black person victimised, overlooked, judged, or at worse, killed because of prejudice. I don’t want ‘them & us’ divisions. I want, and I want my children to do the right thing. 

I want to understand.  #BlackLivesMatter

I wonder how many people have retweeted this and said “Rich Lives Matter”......

#BlackLivesMatter
